correctness.rationale: After factoring e^{ict}, orthogonal basis cos(dt/2), sin(dt/2) has squared norms 1+s_d and 1−s_d, s_d=sin d/d; the Gram representer gives exact K_d(x)=(1−s_d cos dx)/(1−s_d²), with an attained fixed-gap extremizer. For d≥π the bound K_d≤(1−1/π)^{-1}<2≤(1+3x²)/2 is strict. For 0<d<π, |sin(xd/2)|≤|x|sin(d/2) when |x|≥1, and F(d)=d²+d sin d cos d−2sin²d has F(0)=F′(0)=0 and F″=4sin d(sin d−d cos d)>0, so K_d(1)<2. The affine-in-x² comparison and K_d(0)>1/2 yield strict cap. Taylor of s_d and cos(dx) gives coefficient (15x⁴+6x²−5)/120>0 with O_x(d⁴); coalescing frequencies give global supremum and nonattainment for d>0. Independent symbolic differentiation/Taylor and 21 numeric exterior gap checks agreed. The expansion is for fixed x, NOT uniform x→∞.
